title: Nonparametric f-Modeling for Empirical Bayes Inference with Unequal and Unknown Variances
summary: Empirical Bayes methods are widely used for large-scale inference, yet most classical approaches assume homoscedastic observations and focus primarily on posterior mean estimation. We develop a nonparametric empirical Bayes framework for the heteroscedastic normal means problem with unequal and unknown variances.
